newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian church leaders call for famine relief.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian church leaders call for famine relief.

text.p: More than 280,000 people in northern Tanzania are in need of emergency food supplies because of prolonged drought, the semi-official Sunday News reported.
It quoted church leaders in Kilimanjaro, Arusha and Tanga regions as saying that local dams, rivers and springs had dried up, increasing the effect of food shortages in the area.
They called on the Tanzanian government to organise famine relief food supplies, and said church bodies would cooperate in ensuring that such supplies reached the people in need of them.
The drought is affecting a large area of eastern Africa. Neighbouring Kenya has already declared a national emergency to enable the famine relief effort to be stepped up.
